onboarding_welcome_tagline: Private, encrypted notes you can create by voice, by hand, or by scanning a document.
onboarding_bullet1_desc: Just say what to save — Commander routes it here and files it under the right category.
onboarding_bullet2_desc: Organize notes into colored categories, and let Auto-Merge tidy up near-duplicates for you.
onboarding_bullet3_desc: Your notes never leave your phone unless you export them yourself.
onboarding_permissions_intro: Grant this so Vox Notes can confirm things happened, even when it's running in the background. You can change it later in your device Settings.
permission_notif_desc: Needed so the "note saved" confirmation can show when a voice note is created in the background.
commander_required_message: This feature requires Vox Commander to be installed and configured
vision_required_message: This feature requires Vox Vision to be installed
delete_note_message: This note will be permanently deleted.
cleanup_confirm_message: The following field(s) contain only symbols or the text "null":
delete_category_message: Notes in this category will become uncategorized. The notes themselves are not deleted.
voice_save_toast: Toast when a note is saved by voice
voice_save_toast_desc: Show a confirmation (text + category) when VoxCommander saves a note
default_voice_category_desc: Voice notes without a spoken category go here
auto_create_voice_category_desc: If you say a category that doesn't exist, create it (auto-colored) instead of falling back
require_fingerprint_desc: Notes stay encrypted at rest; this gates reading them in the app and via VoxCommander
auto_merge_categories_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find and merge duplicate categories
auto_merge_categories_need_two: Add at least 2 categories to use Auto-Merge
auto_merge_categories_sent_toast: Merge request sent — categories will update automatically
language_setting_desc: Used for the app's own text and for Auto-Merge Categories suggestions
scheduled_merge_desc: Run Auto-Merge Categories automatically on a schedule
find_duplicate_notes_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find redundant/near-duplicate notes for you to review
find_duplicate_notes_need_two: Add at least 2 notes to use this
find_duplicate_notes_sent_toast: Looking for duplicates — check back here shortly
scheduled_dedup_desc: Look for duplicate notes automatically on a schedule (still requires your review before anything is removed)
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
calendar_view_desc: Browse notes as a scrollable, month-paged calendar instead of a plain list
attach_photo_on_scan: Process photo with AI on scan
attach_photo_on_scan_desc: Send the scanned photo to the AI alongside the recognized text (needs Vision's "send photo to AI" setting on too, and a multimodal engine configured)
scan_image_retention_desc: Whether the scanned photo is kept as an attachment on the note after cleanup finishes
delete_attachment_group_message: Every photo in this group will be removed.
notifications_system_default_desc: Use Android system settings for reminders and alerts
notifications_sound_desc: Play a sound when a notification arrives
locked_message: The notes are locked. Unlock the app.
delete_attachment_message: The photo is removed from this record.
backup_import_mode_desc: How restoring a file reconciles it against what's already here. Only applies when Data is on.
backup_import_mode_caveat_merge: Safest: restores the file and deletes only records that existed when it was exported — anything created here afterwards is kept.
backup_import_mode_caveat_full_override: DELETES everything — including records created AFTER the backup — then restores only what the file contains.
backup_import_mode_caveat_additive: Never deletes anything — restoring the same file again DUPLICATES its records.
scan_llm_level: How much AI reads a scan
flow_send_nothing_desc_notes: The scanned text becomes the note as it is.
flow_send_missing: Only what could not be worked out
flow_send_head_desc: Asked about even where the reading already had an answer.
flow_send_everything_desc_notes: The text is tidied up, and a title and category are chosen for it.
notes_fill_head: Fill in the title and category automatically
flow_cannot_suggest: This app has nowhere to hold a suggestion, so an answer is written.
